req_header:

rule_name: Apache Shiro 身份验证绕过漏洞(CVE-2016-6802)
req_header:
GET /admin/dashboard HTTP/1.1
Host: 10.20.30.4:8080
Cookie: rememberMe=2B5d8aQ1kQe3Zx9vN7wFyL0pR4tG6hJkM8cV2bN5xZ1q==
User-Agent: python-requests/2.31.0
Accept: */*
Connection: keep-alive
